thread:
kai (Design): quick UX flag — export CTA hidden in the error tooltip is a recurring support ask. proposing we move a visible `Export trace` button into the drilldown header (right side, next to filters). keep tooltip limited to 'Copy request id' and 'Open full trace'.

san (Product): +1. header-level export improves discovery. microcopy should read: 'Export trace — includes filters, time range, and visible frames.' avoid 'snapshot'.

felix (Eng): backend note: header export means we have to snapshot current filters + timerange server-side and attach correlation ids. doable, adds ~200ms and returns a job id. will return presigned URL when ready.

mei (A11y): accessibility notes: button must be keyboard focusable, have an aria-label containing the request id, e.g. `Export trace (req: 3f7b2a)`. announce export completion via an `aria-live` toast and ensure export modal uses role=dialog and traps focus; focus must return to the export control on close. Prefer `Shift+E` as the shortcut but check for conflicts.

kai (Design): mock updated — Export is outline button on the right grouped with time-filter; tooltip copy shortened to: 'Error context — top frames + metadata. Expand to view stack or copy request id.' inside tooltip small 'Copy id' link. export menu offers JSON (default) and HAR (opt-in).

san (Product): please emit an audit event (user, req id, file type) when export happens for compliance. also add a tiny privacy note in modal about included metadata.

felix (Eng): will add job/audit events. HAR generation behind feature flag. default JSON will include small metadata blob (correlation_id, sample_tags).

preview-bot: preview deployed: https://ui-stage.redwood.ai/trace/174999-export-preview — includes header export, shortcut demo, and JSON export.

san (Product): thanks all. can we do a 15m sign-off tomorrow 9:30am PT?

kai (Design): works for me.

mei (A11y): I'll run a quick pass on the preview and post any issues here. :white_check_mark:
